item.title: Associate professor: MEDS-03/A MICROBIOLOGY AND CLINICAL MICROBIOLOGY (Univ. Catt. S.Cuore)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-14 16:00
Institution: Univ. Catt. S.Cuore, Roma
Field: Medicine / 06/MEDS-03 Microbiologia e microbiologia clinica

The candidate shall carry out teaching activities within the Academic Discipline MEDS/03/A in the Medical Degree Programme, the bachelor’s degree Programmes in the Health Professions, and the Specialty Training Programmes. The candidate shall also develop research activities consistent with the Academic Discipline MEDS/03/A, with particular reference to the biological, molecular, diagnostic and translational aspects of clinical microbiology, including the development and evaluation of innovative approaches for the diagnosis and microbiological management of infectious diseases.
